note: Trading costs and taxes for PSX ready-market trades by individuals, read by services/cost_engine.py only. Version .1 was the Phase 5 proposal of 2026-10-11 and was never used; .2 applies the team's decisions of the same day. Every rate keeps its source and status: verified = read in the official document; unverified = the official page could not be read or only a secondary source states it.
rounding: Each charge line is rounded to the paisa (0.01, half up) per holding and side, as on a contract note; sales tax is computed on the rounded commission line; totals are sums of rounded lines.

commission.applies_to: buy value and sell value, each side
commission.note: PSX/N-1258: higher of Rs 0.03 per share or 0.15% of the value, up to 2.5%. This is the lowest a broker may charge; the user may enter a higher rate.

sales_tax_on_commission.note: Sindh Sales Tax on stockbrokers' services (tariff heading 9819.1000). Confirmed against a broker tariff (KASB commission structure, January 2025: 'Sindh Sales Tax 15% on brokerage'). The 2026-27 Sindh schedule has not been confirmed.

fees.note: CDC transaction fee 0.0036% of market value. The CDC site refuses scripted requests, so the schedule was not read. No minimum: CDC waived minimum fees from 1 July 2024.

Rs 3.50 per Rs 100,000 value traded, ready market. The schedule says sales tax applies 'on the trading fee amount' at 'the applicable rate as notified from time to time', without a rate and without saying the client pays it, so that sales tax is not modelled.
Rs 0.62084 per Rs 100,000 until the schedule's discontinuation date, 29 August 2025; 0 since then.
SECP levy PKR 0.65 per Rs 100,000 value traded, collected by PSX.
Rs 0.81 per Rs 100,000; secondary source only (NCCPL's site refuses scripted requests).
Rs 0.30 per Rs 100,000 charged by NCCPL; secondary source only. The same source lists it separately from the PSX-collected SECP levy, and the PSX schedule does not mention NCCPL, so both are counted.

cvt.note: Capital Value Tax on the purchase of listed shares is 0.00% in the PSX schedule (abolished from 19 April 2020).

cgt.applies_to: gain on sale = sale proceeds after sell charges minus total cost including buy charges; no tax on a loss
cgt.note: 15% on PSX securities acquired from 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025, unchanged by Finance Act 2026). NCCPL reports collecting 15% regardless of ATL status; KPMG reads the law as normal income-tax rates for non-filers. The Division VII text was not found in the scanned Finance Act 2025 (First Schedule Part I amendments, pages 85-91).
cgt.non_filer_label: Non-filer: NCCPL deducts 15%; individuals may owe more at normal income-tax rates.

dividend_wht.note: Section 150, general rate (FBR rate card for tax year 2027). Dividends from IPPs (7.5% / 15%) and from companies paying no tax because of exemptions, losses or credits (25% / 50%) are taxed differently; the general rate is applied to every stock.

not_modelled.text: Setting a capital loss off against other gains, or carrying it forward
NCCPL's charges for computing capital gains tax
Sales tax on the PSX trading fee
